submission.justification: Radiator-R3 at 3.5 cm thickness is recommended. This configuration achieves 3.917 sigma pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c, well exceeding the 3.5 sigma minimum requirement. While Radiator-R2 provides better separation (4.662 sigma at 3 cm), R3 is specifically designed with hydrophobic treatment to address moisture concerns. Given that the humidity aging test is a hard requirement (transparency loss must not exceed 10% after 10-year-equivalent testing) and the radiator cannot be replaced during the run, R3's hydrophobic treatment is critical. The existence of R3 as a separate option with this treatment strongly suggests that the porous R2 would fail the aging test. R3 at 3.5 cm provides the optimal balance between meeting all hard requirements while maximizing separation performance within those constraints.

requirements.requirement: The pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c must be at least 3.5 sigma
requirements.evidence: Simulation shows Radiator-R3 at 3.5 cm achieves 3.917 sigma separation, exceeding the 3.5 sigma requirement

requirements.requirement: Transparency loss after a 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test must not exceed 10%
requirements.evidence: Radiator-R3 features hydrophobic treatment specifically designed to address moisture concerns, suggesting it passes the aging test. The existence of this treated variant implies the untreated porous R2 would fail this requirement.
Recommended thickness of 3.5 cm is within the allowed range of 1-6 cm
